research_intent: Promote Doc230 Plus workflow-tooling research into canonical v2.3.0 SRS requirements.
primary_goals: Reduce token usage and hallucination risk when agents inspect kiwi-planner JSONL workflow outputs.
Expose deterministic read projections for next work, progress, summaries, and work-order profiles.
Add guarded mutation support for checkbox/progress state, logical deletion, and pipeline event emission.
Support read-only migration preview for legacy workflow artifacts.
Repair previous workflow journal identity ambiguity by standardizing on canonical run_id resolution.
out_of_scope: Implementing runtime behavior in this SRS-registration task.
Creating an alternate requirements source of truth outside docs/spec.
Treating discarded first-wave requirements as implementation targets.
